assessment: Do not promote. Source-selection IDs avoid copying words but candidate still fails routing and factual premise fidelity.
comparison_limits: Candidate-only six selected regression inputs, no contemporaneous baseline or holdout rate
No retrieval run; useful concept labels are evaluator judgments, not retrieval results
Synthetic upstream spans in four cases; original Aster keeps actual held extraction
Whole-candidate mechanical admission differs from planned production per-unit isolation

findings.name: original_aster_held_drive
useful: Two independent legal disputes and separate client-question deliverable retained
Conditional retention/lien and return-of-lent-property concepts are relevant discovery hypotheses
Held drive passage did not disappear

factual_actor_errors.issue: Attributes drive retention to owner; original holder is owner's technician and owner makes retention claim
Absence of joint inspection inferred from no report being sent; no report received does not establish no inspection occurred
Invents prohibition on document examination; advocate said documents have not been supplied/examined, not that examination is forbidden
Presents owner as asserting a lien; source reports claimed retention until repair payment, while lien is a candidate legal interpretation

unnecessary_search: Question-drafting work has account selection and three client-facing questions incorrectly used as corpus queries
span_selection: All three work items select whole mixed original message despite offered focused spans, including courtesies, task directions and both disputes
findings.concept_quality: Some useful concepts, but mostly verbose general legal/evidential questions; separate lien and restrictions-on-withholding queries substantially overlap

findings.name: not_supplied_is_not_nonexistent
useful: Independent deposit, drive and question work retained
Factual span excludes greeting and task instructions

factual_actor_errors.issue: Search loses not-supplied qualification and investigates absence of report
Lease termination is assumed although source reports return, not termination
Wrongfully withheld appears as reported basis although lawfulness is what is being investigated

unnecessary_search: Question-drafting work emits three questions-about-questions as legal corpus queries
span_selection: Same broad factual span used for both disputes; exact and usable, but it contains both rather than focused separate spans
findings.concept_quality: Return of loaned property and proof burden are useful; largely generic descriptions, reported/conditional labels misused
missing_work_or_limits: No-send restriction absent from all work constraints, though still in original context

findings.name: actor_agency_and_explicit_alternative
useful: Authorised hypothetical retained separately from actual denial
Agency, client and hospital roles remain distinguishable
Agency authority and third-party reliance are meaningfully related concepts

factual_actor_errors.issue: Unreviewed written agreement becomes absence of written agreement; unforwarded email becomes lack of email evidence
Assumed no email expands into no written confirmation; other written forms are not excluded by original hypothetical

unnecessary_search: Actual-account analysis made separate current work without citing latest comparative instruction; may support comparison but is not properly bound

findings.contract_friction: First work omits latest original source; whole-candidate admission discards the second otherwise mechanically valid work
findings.production_isolation_limit: A production per-work admission boundary could preserve the second hypothetical work despite the first work missing current authority. That is potential recovery of an independent unit, not a successful pilot or semantic acceptance: the second work still broadens absent email into absent written confirmation.

findings.name: mixed_independent_requests_followup
useful: Both interim explanation and resumed permission/access inquiry retained
Earlier contrary access claim and open ownership preserved
Permission expiry and independent access right are useful distinct investigations
span_selection: Instruction to explain interim relief selected as factual account; resume-task instruction also selected as account alongside original facts
findings.contract_friction: Uses offered, owned span IDs in sources where schema expects whole-source IDs. This is a field/namespace distinction failure, not evidence that selected words were fabricated.

findings.name: correction_no_send_no_law
useful: Correction, amount uncertainty and no-send limit remain recognised
Earlier original source selected rather than NM error as factual proof

span_selection: Includes correction instruction in supposed legal-search factual account
findings.concept_quality: Searches are unnecessary; relevance cannot redeem wrong task routing

unnecessary_search: Three tenancy enquiries and earlier account selected when expected work was empty

next_decision: Retain production unchanged. Root is considering a research-only responsibility instead of all-work planning; no next candidate or additional paid run is authorised by this assessment. Do not add semantic keyword patches or silently clean returned queries.
